column3: “Leaders” specifies the esteemed; “for fear” specifies the purpose of avoiding a vain run.
“This issue arose” supplies an opening clause.
An hour is rendered as “a moment.”
“To preach” is supplied; circumcision and uncircumcision are rendered as people.
The plural right hands are rendered as singular “the right hand.”
The sentence about being crucified with Christ is placed in BSB’s next verse.
The opening sentence is in verse 19 in the Greek; “and Christ” is not expressed.
